title: BUGFIX — cmdSetUrl display count includes dry-run posts
rationale: cmdSetUrl() shows '${withUrl}/${total} posts have URLs' where total = readLines() — all entries including 3 dry-runs. Should use readRealPosts() for display count (same pattern as Sprint 1391 fix in cmdPosted/cmdUpdateViews). With 18 total lines and 3 dry-runs, display shows wrong denominator.

tasks.description: In scripts/telegram-commands/cmd-management.ts cmdSetUrl(): replace readLines-based withUrl/total count with readRealPosts() after writing. Display should show real posts only (excludes dry-runs).
